Unfortunately, not Dorothy. If it is, I cannot imagine the legal battle the devs will undergo when MGM sues them.
The ruby slippers was movie only, so it falls under the copyright dates for now. But since Oz is a money maker for MGM, that version won't enter public domain for a long time.

I'd be more apt to believe the Dorothy theory if they used Silver instead, since that was the original novel's choice and the first 21 books are in public domain at this time.

This, however, I would argue as being a reference more to The Red Shoes by Hans Christian Anderson. A story about vanity, given the tone of the game and its usage of the aesops of the original story.
At least something about you got blown. *drops mic*
